In GTA 6 you can sneak into a police impound, choke out the officer inside and drive your car right out the gate.

Gameplay: NextGenPlayz (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you sneak in or go in guns blazing? 🚔
clips.motivo: Stealing from a police lot + chokehold on a cop + cruiser waiting outside

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 you can rob the *police impound*?
Jump the *Do Not Enter* gate and sneak past rows of cruisers.
There's an *officer* inside, so you put him in a *chokehold*.
He drops, and the car is all yours.
Floor it out through the *open gate*.
A *cruiser* sits outside. Now they're *hunting* you.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #7: Rob the POLICE IMPOUND 🚔

clips.descripcion:
In GTA 6 cops search for your vehicle's description, so a Pay 'n' Spray respray lets you roll right past them.

Gameplay: NextGenPlayz (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: What color are you painting your getaway car? 🚨
clips.motivo: Wanted description + respray + cruiser passes by, clear crime-consequence rule

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 cops get your *car's description*?
Keep driving it and they'll *recognize* it.
So hit a *Pay 'n' Spray* and change the color.
Cops spot you *faster* if you never change your look.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #8: Cops Have Your CAR'S DESCRIPTION 🚨

clips.descripcion:
In GTA 6 cops can recognize you, but swapping your hat, glasses or outfit clears it so they can't ID you.

Gameplay: NextGenPlayz (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you change outfits after every crime? 👀
clips.motivo: New recognition/disguise system tied to police

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 cops can *recognize your face*?
Swap your *hat and glasses* to lower your recognition.
Then buy a whole new *outfit* at the store.
Clear your recognition and *cops can't ID you*.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #9: Cops RECOGNIZE Your Face 👀
